# SeaWindow: Tide Times & Charts

> Official app website by Mohamed Elatabany.

SeaWindow shows tide predictions, coastal weather, sun and moon times on iPhone with iOS 18 or later. Today’s view and one favorite coast are free; Pro adds a ten-day outlook and additional tools. Data coverage varies; modeled water levels are labelled estimates. It is a planning aid, not a navigation or safety tool.

Canonical App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6811683172

- [SeaWindow: Tide Times, Charts and Coastal Weather](https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/)

## Guides

### How to read a tide chart

https://atabany.github.io/seawindow-site/how-to-read-a-tide-chart.html (updated 2026-11-04)

A tide chart is a curve of predicted water height over time: peaks are high tides, dips are low tides, and every height is measured from a datum (MLLW at NOAA stations in the US). Worked example: NOAA station 9414290, San Francisco (Golden Gate), 5 November 2026: low 0.9 ft at 1:47 AM, high 5.9 ft at 8:35 AM, low 0.7 ft at 2:48 PM, high 4.7 ft at 9:03 PM (MLLW); mean sea level is 3.12 ft above MLLW there. In SeaWindow the Today tab’s Tides card shows the water level now, Rising or Falling, the next high and low, the station, its distance, the provider and, under “Tide table & source”, the datum. Predictions exclude weather; SeaWindow is a planning aid, not a navigation or safety tool.
